extracted_concepts.name: Linear Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A map T: V -> W satisfying T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v) and T(cu) = cT(u).

extracted_concepts.name: Vector Space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The domain and codomain setting for linear transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Rotation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An example of a linear transformation in R^2 or R^3.

extracted_concepts.name: Reflection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An example of a linear transformation in R^2 or R^3.

extracted_concepts.name: Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An example of a linear transformation in R^2 or R^3.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: D(p) = p', a linear transformation from P_n to P_{n-1}.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation p -> integral from 0 to x of p(t) dt.

extracted_concepts.name: Kernel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ker(T) = {v in V : T(v) = 0}.

extracted_concepts.name: Image
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Im(T) = {T(v) : v in V}; for matrices, the column space.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dim(Ker T) + dim(Im T) = dim(V).

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: After choosing bases, T corresponds to a matrix A with [T(v)]_B = A[v]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Composition of Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combining transformations; corresponds to matrix multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The matrix operation representing composition of linear transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Replacing one basis by another and updating coordinates or matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix P satisfying [x]_B = P[x]_B'.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A chosen set of vectors used to form coordinates.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrices related by A' = P^{-1}AP under a change of basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Inner Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A generalization of the dot product with symmetry, linearity, and positive definiteness.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A property of inner products: ⟨u, v⟩ = ⟨v, u⟩.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A property of inner products in each argument.

extracted_concepts.name: Positive Definiteness
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A property of inner products: ⟨v, v⟩ > 0 for nonzero v.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vectors are orthogonal if ⟨u, v⟩ = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Gram-Schmidt Process
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converts any basis to an orthonormal basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthonormal Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A basis of mutually orthogonal unit vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Squares
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Best approximate solution to Ax = b via x̂ = (A^T A)^{-1}A^T b.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Proj_W v = sum_i ⟨v, q_i⟩q_i for an orthonormal basis {q_i} of W.

extracted_concepts.name: Angle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A geometric notion enabled by an inner product.

extracted_concepts.name: Distance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A geometric notion enabled by an inner product.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The coordinate column [v]_B of a vector relative to a basis.
